name: Corona Hills Plaza
demographics: Corona Hills Plaza serves the growing Corona community in Riverside County, attracting middle-income families and working professionals with household incomes ranging from $60,000 to $100,000 annually. The primary trade area draws from the surrounding residential neighborhoods with a mix of young families, established homeowners, and retirees seeking convenient shopping options. Shoppers typically visit for everyday needs and services, with a focus on value-oriented retail and practical amenities rather than luxury shopping experiences.
description: Corona Hills Plaza is a community shopping center located at 350 North McKinley Street in Corona, California, serving as a convenient retail destination for local residents. Managed by Kimco Realty, one of North America's largest publicly traded owners and operators of open-air, grocery-anchored shopping centers, the plaza provides essential shopping and services to the Corona community. The center maintains a strong reputation with a 4.3-star rating from nearly 5,000 customer reviews, reflecting its role as a trusted neighborhood shopping destination. Strategically positioned in the heart of Corona, the plaza offers accessible parking and a practical mix of tenants catering to everyday needs. With operating hours from 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM, Corona Hills Plaza continues to serve as a reliable community gathering place for residents of Riverside County.
summary: Corona Hills Plaza is a community shopping center in Corona, California, managed by Kimco Realty and serving local residents with convenient retail and services. With a strong 4.3-star rating from nearly 5,000 reviews, it has established itself as a trusted neighborhood destination.
